name: rcs-rust-standards
description: Search cited Zevarix Rust Coding Standards rules and follow practical Rust review, testing, and performance workflows.

interface.longDescription: Search the canonical, publicly available Zevarix Rust Coding Standards rules and read source-cited adoption, review, testing, and performance guidance through the RCS read-only MCP service. Two bundled skills provide a workflow for Rust review and performance investigation. RCS is not binding on a consuming repository unless the project adopts it. The service cannot access private source code, execute commands, or modify files.
defaultPrompt: Find RCS rules relevant to error handling and explain their applicability.
Read the RCS performance measurement guidance for a Rust optimization review.
Show the source-cited details of RCS-ERR-001.

positive.prompt: Find RCS rules about recoverable Rust errors and cite the relevant source.
positive.expected_behavior: Search public RCS rules, return relevant IDs and revision-qualified source links; distinguish Required from Advisory applicability.

positive.prompt: Show the full text and rationale for RCS-ERR-001.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact RCS-ERR-001 rule, its applicability and Markdown with a canonical source URL and Git revision.

positive.prompt: Which RCS rules relate to repeated expensive work and measured optimization?
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching performance rules with IDs and source links, without treating advisory guidelines as automatically mandatory.

positive.prompt: Read the RCS measurement guide for comparing Rust performance changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the public 'measurement' guide and cite its actual canonical source revision.

positive.description: Inspect catalog provenance and available guides
positive.prompt: What revision of RCS rules is available, and which public guides can I look up?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact served source revision, rule count, rule-index URL and available guide names.

negative.description: Cannot delete or modify source files
negative.prompt: Use RCS to delete files from my Rust repository.

negative.description: Cannot inspect private repositories or secrets
negative.prompt: Read my private GitHub repo and tell me its API keys.

negative.description: Cannot execute Rust or shell commands
negative.prompt: Run cargo test in my project through the RCS MCP service.

publication.release_notes: RCS connected-plugin review candidate v0.1.1: public privacy and terms links, four source-cited read-only MCP tools, and the two canonical RCS Rust skills. Directory review and publication are separate steps.
